original.target_description: Ready and Wright (2011), ECLS-K fall/spring kindergarten teacher perceptions of literacy; unique predictor, model and critical test unresolved because the assigned target has no locator or description.

replication.target_description: Unassigned placeholder; replication source not inspected.

notes: Assigned original unfinished fields only; replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. Primary title and DOI match supplied reference. No study_o, description, or original locator is supplied, so no unique outcome/predictor/model/time/test can be identified. Tables 1–5 provide multiple candidates; none is selected by row order, numeric matching, or the requested ser_method label. Candidate model sample at p. 341 and Tables 1–5: 9,493 children nested in 1,822 classrooms nested in 701 schools; these are separate levels, not additive groups. No N arithmetic performed. Selection requires nonmissing child weights, same school and teacher throughout kindergarten, complete sociodemographics, both fall/spring literacy assessments and teacher ratings; complete teacher background/classroom information; nonmissing school weights and at least three ECLS-K children. This common N is retained only as candidate evidence for field-scope review. Candidate effects: Table 3 female fall Model 1 .25***, fall Model 2 .14***, spring Model 1 .29***, spring Model 2 .14***; social class .24***, .10***, .26***, .09*** in the same column sequence. Table 4 class average achievement .32*** fall and .36*** spring; Table 5 Black teacher effect on SES slope .124** fall and .062 spring. Table 3 footnotes explicitly standardize the outcome and the social-class measure; metric is printed HLM estimates in SD units, not an independently established ser_method transformation. Table 3 female candidate p bounds are < .001 for each model (***); social class candidates likewise < .001; Table 4 achievement candidates < .001; Table 5 Black-teacher/SES-slope fall candidate < .01 (**), spring unstarred with no exact p supplied. Candidate p bounds are attached only to their own candidate tests, never assigned to this unresolved target. Canonical text renders minus signs as 2 and less-than signs as backslashes in several tables; PDF pages 7, 13, 15, 16, 18 inspected for layout and glyphs. Canonical evidence preserves its literal text. No metric conversion or N derivation.
